en: One fascicle of the *Cangqudu nü tuoluoni jing* (Sūtra of the Dhāraṇī of the Poisonous Woman) by the Zenrin-ji Sōjō Sōei;
one fascicle of the *Da suiqiu tuoluoni pi ben* (Manuscript of the Great Paritrāṇā Dhāraṇī).

One fascicle of the *Dafo ding* (Great Buddha-Crown) Stele Text; the three fascicles above were transmitted by the Ācārya. One fascicle of the *Ponana Jieshi Bo* (Bhāvanā-kleśa-bha? Recitation Ritual;
one fascicle of the *Gongyang Hushi Tian Fa* (Rite for Making Offerings to the World-Protecting Devas). Compiled by the Ācārya Faquan:
the *Nalayan Tian Gong Axulou Wang Douzheng Fabao Siwei Sanzang* (The Dharma-Treasure Contemplation of the Tripitaka Master on the Battle between Nārāyaṇa and the Asura King).
The Translation of the *Svabhāva-vajra-dharmas* (1 fascicle); the General Explanation of the Meaning of Dhāraṇīs and the Praise (1 fascicle);
the Yoga Practice Method of the Tathāgata Avalokiteśvara-rāja from the *Vajraśekhara-sūtra* (1 fascicle);
the *Uṣṇīṣavijayā-hṛdaya-dhāraṇī* along with its Separate Rituals; and the *Brief Exposition of the Vajraśekhara Yoga* in Thirty Sections.
*The Essential Heart-Mantra of the Seven Honored Ones*, one fascicle; *The Compendium of the True Sūtra for Accomplishing the Three Bodies:
A Summary of Secret Mantras*, one fascicle; *The Mañjuśrī-Yamāntaka-Vajra Dhāraṇī Sūtra*, one fascicle; *The Ritual Procedures for Yoga Offerings*, one fascicle;
*The Five-Wheel Contemplation Gate of the Womb Realm*, one fascicle; *The Record and Decisions on Bodhicitta*, one fascicle.
One fascicle: *The Decisive Exposition on the Essential Principles of the Prajñāpāramitā*. One fascicle: *General Exposition on the Yoga of Cintāmaṇicakra*.
One fascicle: *The Ritual for the Practice and Offering of Mahācakra-vajra*. One fascicle: *The Special Practice Method of King Vaiśravaṇa*.
One fascicle: *The Nāṭakubera Dhāraṇī Sūtra*. One fascicle: *The Ritual Manual of King Vaiśravaṇa*. Vaiśravaṇa... [text truncated]
*The Sūtra of the Heavenly Kings of the Gates*, one fascicle; *The Universal Sage’s Sūtra for Prolonging Life of All Tathāgatas*, one fascicle;
*The Dharma of the Mantras of the Four Heavenly Sister Goddesses*, one fascicle (containing within it one copy of the *Mantra of the Inner Buddha-uṣṇīṣa*);
*The Method for the随心 [Sui-xin] Mantra of Avalokiteśvara Bodhisattva*, one fascicle; *The Recitation Method of Vajrakumāra*, one fascicle. [End.]
